about_the_game:
The Evil Rise is a terrifying new entry in survival horror, blending psychological dread, grotesque bio-horror, and immersive first-person gameplay in one intense experience.

You play as Liam Harper, who returns to his family’s long-abandoned mansion—now overrun by the horrifying results of Nexon-9, a bio-research experiment that twisted human lives into something monstrous.

Set in modern-day rural America, The Evil Rise invites you to explore the decaying Harper estate, where every shadow hides a secret and every door could lead to your end. Confront relentless enemies, solve cryptic puzzles, and uncover the truth behind your family’s dark legacy.

Powered by Unreal Engine 5, every flicker of light, distant scream, and blood-stained hallway is rendered with chilling detail, drawing you deeper into a world where survival is never guaranteed.

Key Features:

  • Atmospheric, story-driven exploration of a decaying mansion

  • Strategic survival against grotesque, fast-moving enemies

  • Challenging puzzles woven into the narrative and environment

  • Stunning visuals and audio powered by Unreal Engine 5

Will you survive the mansion's twisted legacy… or become part of it?

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains intense violence, blood and gore, disturbing imagery, and themes of psychological horror. Players will confront grotesque, mutated creatures and experience moments of dread, fear, and tension throughout a dark, story-driven setting.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 12
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 Ti / AMD RX 6800
  • DirectX: Version 12

short_description: Trapped in his family’s abandoned mansion, Liam Harper must survive the night against horrifying, mutated creatures created by the deadly Nexon-9 experiment. Uncover dark secrets, confront his family's haunting legacy, and fight to escape in this immersive first-person survival horror.
